title: NPA-Révolutionnaires Announces Third Far-Left Presidential Candidacy for 2027 Election
detail: The NPA-Révolutionnaires (New Anti-Capitalist Party – Revolutionaries) announced a third far-left presidential candidacy for the 2027 French presidential election, further fragmenting an already divided left-wing field. The announcement adds to the crowded slate of hard-left contenders ahead of the election, complicating efforts by the broader left to consolidate behind a single challenger to Macron's centrist bloc and the far-right Rassemblement National.
